items.title: To survive, the Liberals must now get over their self-obsession
items.description: By its new leader Angus Taylor's own admission, the Liberal Party is running out of time to pull out of the nosedive that has it heading towards oblivion.

items.title: It took 80 years for a woman to become Liberal leader, and 9 months to dump her
items.description: Sussan Ley vowed to be a different opposition leader, one who consulted widely and listened to her broad church. But it left many wondering what, if anything, she stood for.

items.title: Angus Taylor just got an unwelcome parting gift from the leader he deposed
items.description: Within two hours of being elected Liberal leader, Angus Taylor has already been delivered his first big electoral test, and it has come from the woman he deposed.

items.title: Rain and storms forecast for Qld after record-breaking outback drenching
items.description: This rare desert drenching is the result of an intrusion of very humid tropical air — an air mass — which is now over Queensland, where it will stall for several days.

items.title: Live: Australia rocked by Zimbabwe triple-strike in run chase of 170
items.description: After a comfortable win in the World Cup opener earlier this week, Australia looks to consolidate its spot in Group B with a win over Zimbabwe in Colombo. Follow live.

items.title: 'Nobody is safe' from watchful gaze of Bald Archies satirical art prize
items.description: From the trial of Erin Patterson to the landslide election victory, 2025 is pilloried in this year's satirical art prize, the Bald Archy.

items.title: New details emerge of night Labor identity Tim Picton fatally injured
items.description: A man who allegedly killed Tim Picton in a one-punch attack outside a Perth nightclub claims the Labor identity had repeatedly approached his female cousin before being escorted out of the venue because he was intoxicated, a Perth court hears.

items.title: Children's author jailed over 'predatory' sexual messages to minors
items.description: Oliver Phommavanh was sentenced to six-and-a-half years in prison, with a non-parole period of four years.

items.title: Alice Springs woman survives 12-hour flood ordeal on Todd River
items.description: When her mum was swept into the flooding Todd River this week, Alice Springs woman Latarne Wayne went in after her.

items.title: US man linked to Wieambilla shooting handed three-year prison sentence
items.description: A US-based conspiracy theorist with links to the Wieambilla shooters is handed a three-year sentence for firearms offences.

items.title: Police watchdog to investigate actions of officers during protest clashes
items.description: The Law Enforcement Conduct Commission says it will investigate the police response to the demonstration at Town Hall against Israeli President Isaac Herzog's visit on Monday night.

items.title: Epstein survivor slams 'deeply upsetting' handling of files
items.description: Lisa Phillips says the publication of the "Epstein" files was meant to deliver long-promised transparency but has instead exposed victims, deepened trauma and continued to shield powerful men.

items.title: Families 'sick of waiting for solution' as 3,100 aged care patients stranded
items.description: With the ink still wet on a new hospital deal, state and territory health ministers will today use a meeting with their federal counterpart to call for urgent action on stranded patients.

items.title: How the judges will decide Scotty James's halfpipe fate
items.description: Scotty James is about to face the biggest competition of his life — so what will he need to do to impress those who will decide his Olympic fate?

items.title: How the ASX went from rooster to feather duster
items.description: A decade of technology failures, unplanned outages, management upheaval, irate investors and the torching of hundreds of millions of dollars has left the ASX's reputation in shreds.

items.title: Cocaine ship heads towards Sydney after being stripped of cargo
items.description: A ship caught carrying five tonnes of cocaine is making its way towards Sydney after being stripped of its cargo.

items.title: 'Hate has been given an outlet': Why Jack Thorne made a new Lord of the Flies
items.description: After winning an Emmy for writing Adolescence, Jack Thorne's latest project, a TV adaptation of Lord of the Flies, also sits at the intersection of vulnerability, masculinity and violence.

items.title: 'They found her grave': The words a stolen boy waited decades to hear
items.description: More than 100 Stolen Generations survivors have gathered in Canberra for the apology anniversary. The government is pledging new money to help them heal.

items.title: Sweeping reforms to boost Sydney's live music scene
items.description: The state government introduces what it describes as a "world first" bill to support the live music scene.

items.title: Maugean skate's endangered status not changing, environment minister says
items.description: Environment Minister Murray Watt says his decision to keep the status of a rare Tasmanian skate species as endangered rather than change it to critically endangered is based on scientific advice.

items.title: Trump repeals landmark climate finding
items.description: President Donald Trump's administration has revoked a scientific determination that has been the central basis for US action to fight climate change.

items.title: Who is the Gucci-wearing teen who could be North Korea's next leader?
items.description: South Korea's spy agency says that Kim Jong Un is set to choose his daughter as his heir, extending his family's rule into a fourth generation.

items.title: How is the Lunar New Year of the Horse celebrated in Australia?
items.description: The Year of the Horse is here and 2026 is a rare "Red Horse" year. Find out what it means, which zodiac animal you are, and how Lunar New Year is celebrated across Australia.

items.title: 'Just not Formula 1': Verstappen says new cars aren't fun to drive
items.description: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Max Verstappen says the 2026 cars are "not so fun", claiming the increasing energy management demands on drivers are "just not Formula 1".

items.title: FBI focuses on backpack clue as Savannah Guthrie shares montage of kidnapped mother
items.description: The FBI increases its reward and releases new images as part of its investigation into the suspected abduction of US television host Savannah Guthrie's mother, Nancy, from her southern Arizona home.
